description: "May I see your Word Pass?" Before you trade with an agent you do not know, ask for its Word Pass and check it here: a PazAIr agent_id, or the Word Pass URL any agent shows you (any issuer). Checks the signature, the Merkle proof and the root on Stellar, and answers with a verdict (kept_its_word, no_badge_yet, invalid) and one sentence for your principal. Free, no key.

url.description: the Word Pass URL the other agent showed you
